topic: The Mystery of π in the Normal Distribution: The Gaussian Integral

sections.title: The Hook: The Gaussian Bell Curve
lecture_lines: Look at the standard normal curve.
Why is π in linear distributions?
animations: Fade in standard normal distribution curve in #FFFFFF.
Highlight the function formula containing π in #FF00FF.
Show a question mark next to the π term.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Normalization Condition
lecture_lines: Probability requires area to be one.
animations: Fade in the expression for the Gaussian integral.
Label the integral expression as 'I' in #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Mathematical Trick: Squaring the Integral
lecture_lines: To solve I, we square it.
animations: Display the equation I^2 = Integral * Integral.
Show the transition to a double integral.
Visualize the 2D surface representing the product.

sections.title: The Polar Coordinate Transformation
lecture_lines: Switch from rectangular to polar coordinates.
The variables shift to r and θ.
animations: Animate transition from x,y to r,θ.
Show the transformation formulas for r and θ.
Draw a polar grid overlay in #66FF66.

sections.title: Solving and Synthesis
lecture_lines: I equals the square root of π.
animations: Display the integration process over r and θ.
Highlight the factor 2π appearing in the result.
Show the final derivation: I = sqrt(π).
